title: A toss up between which is worse....the original bad smell or this spray.
text: A toss up between which is worse....the original bad smell or this spray.. This spray does get rid of bad odors - particularly those found in the rest room. It works pretty quickly and has a manual push button spray nozzle - this allows you to control the amount of the Stinky Winky you actually use. Which is a good thing. The Stinky Winky itself is questionable with regard to its own scent. It has a combination of citronella and peppermint and eucalyptus and other stuff. All those things should smell fresh....yet....it's almost like a weird mix of bug repellant and those dried eucalyptus leaves you used to put in vases for decorating. I am going to reserve this stuff for the very worst smells only.
